caption: The drawing is a technical illustration of a slate-top table, composed in black ink with red highlights and measurements. The image features three main views of the table: a top view, a front elevation, and a side elevation. The top view, located in the top left corner, displays an octagonal tabletop with black outlined edges and a decorative design within, marked with red lines and curves forming a symmetrical pattern that includes four corner circles and a central motif. Below the top view, the front elevation illustrates two turned legs on each side, an ornate apron featuring three decorative drops, and two drawers with intricately shaped keyhole escutcheons, all outlined in black. The side elevation, to the right of the front view, displays two legs joined by a horizontal stretcher and a central ornament. Both elevation views are flanked with red arrows and numbers marking the dimensions: the table measures 36 inches in length, 17 inches in width, and 28½ inches in height. To the top right of the image, handwritten text in black ink describes the table, including the materials, historical context, and museum collection details, and provides the drawing's scale as 1/8 inch equals 1 inch. The overall composition is executed on a beige or off-white background.
title: Slate-top Table
